description:
You are a Senior Site Reliability Engineer at a high-growth SaaS company. Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Your engineering team has experienced three production incidents over the past month. Post-incident review meetings were completed and findings were posted in team channels, but the resulting action items have not been tracked, owned, or followed up on. Some of these unresolved items are directly increasing the risk of repeat incidents.

Review the relevant team channels, identify the unresolved postmortem action items, ensure they are properly catalogued with owners and deadlines, notify the responsible engineers, and establish a tracking mechanism so leadership can monitor remediation progress.
